note: The authored layout of the raft town in the Sound. A template has no position; this file is the placement data. tools/sea_town.py translates it into the settlement record, the Centre and Mart placements and one earthwork per district in data/placements.json (so tools/place_town.py builds it as a town, re-apply step R8), refuses a raft over land or over water shallower than its rule, overlapping elements, a bridge that does not join two decks, and a deck walk cell below min_light in its lantern model. Ground is the canonical heightmap (tools/ground.py, rounded), never a world: the seabed under a post is round(h) and the deck is the world's sea level from data/world.json. Coordinates are inclusive [x0, z0, x1, z1] rectangles.

site.why_here: Measured on the canonical heightmap (tools/sea_town.py plan). The doc's estimate (7120, 6880) is over the bay's deep hole, 32 blocks of water, with the deepest water (36 to 39) just south-west of it; rafts there would stand on 30-block posts and nothing would reach from the shore. The jungle island's north-west shelf, 90 blocks east-south-east, is 3 to 20 deep across x7150-7250 z6900-7015 and falls into the hole on its west side, so the Old Rafts sit on the shelf, reach from the jungle shore into open water, and Fishers' Row runs west off the shelf into the Sound's deepest water (36+). The mainland jetty is on the South-East Dunes' beach at (7092, 6711), not at the doc's (7150, 6620), which is dry ground y64+ behind the beach; the town is about 190 blocks across the water from its landing. The Current Gate is at the bay's south-west mouth, off the jungle island's shore at (7094, 7230).

levels.deck: data/world.json vertical.sea_level (y62): the deck replaces the top water layer

rules.why: Rafts, piers and the gate's raft float over at least 3 blocks of water, so a boat passes round them and the posts are visible; the walks that come ashore (the jetty, the yard's wharf, the stilt boardwalk) may reach the beach, never ground above the deck. Lanterns (never light blocks): one on a post at every raft corner and every lamp_every blocks along the edges and walks, and the tool refuses the plan if its model leaves any open deck cell at the walk level below min_light.

districts.name: Old Rafts
districts.what: the Pacifidlog core: sixteen log rafts on the jungle island's north-west shelf, joined by bamboo bridges; the Centre and the Mart on the two largest, a hut on each of twelve, the town square with the waystone

districts.name: Fishers' Row
districts.what: a mangrove pier 5 wide and 120 long west off the shelf into the Sound's deepest water, a T-head at its end, a fishing station every 8 blocks, and the Fishing Guild hall and its smokehouse at the root

districts.name: Boatwright's Yard
districts.what: a spruce wharf against the jungle shore north-east of the rafts: an open boat shed over a hull in frame, a slipway into the water, a boat rack and a barrel of boats, bamboo rafts moored off it

districts.name: Stilt Quarter
districts.what: seven houses and the inn on mangrove stilts along a boardwalk in the shallows south of the rafts, mangrove roots round the stilts; the inn has beds

districts.name: Current Gate
districts.what: a floating spruce breakwater off the jungle island's shore at the bay's south-west mouth, a raft at its end with a lookout tower, the swimmer's hut and three stations facing the open sea

districts.name: Mainland jetty
districts.what: the way in: a bamboo jetty from the South-East Dunes' beach out to a landing in 3-5 blocks of water, a boat rack, a barrel of boats, a signpost to the Mining Town and one pointing across the Sound

service_materials.why: Re-materialed in the placement (tools/place_town.py writes the copy into the build pack, never into kits/): the Centre keeps its red roof and the Mart its blue one, which are what name them; walls, trim, floor course and planting take the raft town's bamboo and jungle wood, like for like (stairs for stairs, slab for slab, a tall plant for a tall plant). The gardens lose their flowers for ferns and moss: nothing a raft carries decides a spawn beyond the Centre's machines, which are whitelisted.

racks.why: the boatwright's rack; its barrel holds boats

boats_why: A boat is an entity: one taken from a rack is gone from it. The racks are blocks, and each has a barrel beside it holding six oak boats; the barrel is shared, and only the re-application refills it (a keeper function, as the Celebi's, is the doc's open idea, NOT VERIFIED). Boats are vanilla, not Cobblemon items, and the town is otherwise reachable only by swimming or a water mount.
